error_signals: The agent adjusted the 'preventive' maintenance schedule (schedule_id 2) in addition to the 'calibration' schedule. The task explicitly requested shifting 'all future calibration due dates' and updating the next due date from 2024-07-30 to 2024-08-13, which corresponds only to the calibration schedule. Modifying the preventive schedule was an unauthorized change.

judge_result.reasoning: The agent was tasked with adjusting only the calibration schedule for the X-ray unit 'XRAY-MOB-5521', shifting its next due date from 2024-07-30 to 2024-08-13. The database diff confirms that the calibration schedule (id=1) was correctly updated with the new due date. However, the agent also incorrectly updated the preventive maintenance schedule (id=2), changing its next due date from 2024-06-15 to 2024-06-29. This violates the explicit instruction to only modify the calibration schedule. Although the final answer provided by the agent correctly describes the changes made, the actual database changes include an unauthorized modification to the preventive schedule. Therefore, the task is classified as incomplete because the agent failed to adhere to the scope of the request.

task: Adjust the existing preventive maintenance schedule for portable X-ray unit 'XRAY-MOB-5521' (model Carestream DRX-Revolution Nano, serial #DRX-NANO-2022-5521) to shift all future calibration due dates forward by 14 days because of an approved vendor delay; update the next due date from 2024-07-30 to 2024-08-13 and preserve all historical log entries and escalation rules.
